summary: The agent executed a rigorous audit and minimal viable replication (MVR-0) of the paper's core mechanism (ES/FR Original vs Shift Ori) in an isolated virtual environment. It downloaded the first 50,000 vectors of the public MUSE Spanish and French embeddings, reimplemented the pipeline with clean unit tests, and ran extensive diagnostic grids across classifier and PCA variants. It successfully reproduced ES Original MWEAT (3.6918), ES Shift Ori MWEAT (0.3088 vs 0.3090) via the buggy PCA + LinearSVC path, the direction cosine (0.3885 vs 0.389), and classifier accuracies, while demonstrating that the permutation p-value test fails due to tie degeneracy (73.2% ties in ES). It properly halted before full Table 1 and Table 2 due to the p-value gate failure and unreleased evaluation scripts, providing exceptionally well-calibrated reports.
